title: brain install manifest
description: One manifest per client install. The ONLY thing that differs between installs. Fields marked NOT YET WIRED are read by nothing today; they are kept because they describe intent, but do not tell a client they take effect.

slug.description: Lowercase. Used to name the worker, the D1 database and the Vectorize index, so it cannot contain spaces or capitals.

domain.description: NOT YET WIRED as provisioning. Nothing creates this route; health and test will PROBE it if set, so leave it out until the DNS and route exist or every command will fail against a hostname that does not resolve.

storage.description: d1 keeps the entire brain inside the client's own Cloudflare account and is the standard backend at every corpus size. supabase exists only for migration or an explicitly measured retrieval limitation.

d1_database_name.description: Must be scoped to the client, e.g. acme-brain. A bare "brain" is refused at provision: it may already exist in the account and belong to something else.

vectorize_index.description: Created by provision at 768 dimensions, cosine. Those are the output shape of @cf/baai/bge-base-en-v1.5 and are not free choices. Requires the Workers Paid plan.

r2_bucket.description: Created by provision, but NOT YET WIRED: nothing binds or reads it.

kv_namespace.description: NOT YET WIRED. Never created, never bound.

corpora.description: Source declarations. Google Drive policy is enforced by brain ingest --from drive. Other connector declarations may remain descriptive until their command is documented.

exclude_file_ids_file.description: Optional local JSON exclusion list, resolved relative to the manifest. It may also be a completed Supabase migration receipt.

retrieval.description: chunk_size, chunk_overlap and answer_model are deployed as Worker configuration. The standard answer model runs through the client-owned Cloudflare Workers AI binding. Other fields remain descriptive until their runtime wiring is documented.

private_path_prefixes.description: Enforced per path segment on local-folder and Google Drive ingest. Gmail has no folder path and does not use this rule.

operations.description: Machine-local unattended operations. ingest_cron is wired through the macOS Drive LaunchAgent scheduler. Health reports and webhooks remain descriptive until their commands are implemented.

ingest_cron.description: Numeric five-field cron schedule for unattended Google Drive ingest. Installed as a per-user macOS LaunchAgent; calendar times use the Mac's local timezone. brain.domain must also be set so refresh needs no Cloudflare deployment credential.

admin_key_secret.description: Optional non-secret macOS Keychain locator, keychain://<service>/<account>, for the brain admin key used by unattended ingest. The secret value never enters the manifest or plist. If absent, the adjacent .brain-admin-key file is the durable LaunchAgent fallback; ADMIN_KEY applies only to a directly invoked runner because launchd does not inherit terminal exports.

google_token_store.description: Durable Google OAuth token-store choice for unattended ingest. auto uses macOS Keychain; file preserves an explicit BRAIN_GOOGLE_TOKEN_STORE=file connection choice across sparse LaunchAgent environments.

health_cron.description: NOT YET WIRED. No health scheduler is installed today.

health_report_email.description: NOT YET WIRED. No report email is sent today.

alert_webhook_secret.description: NOT YET WIRED. No alert webhook is called today.

authorized_emails.description: NOT YET WIRED. Read by nothing. Auth is a single admin key: anyone holding it sees everything.
